primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: エシェクの子ウラムを長子として明記する。
primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 直前で名を挙げたウラムの子らについて記す。
primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, L–Z
wikipediaRead.locator: L1820–1822. The entry explicitly distinguishes the Ulam in 1 Chronicles 7:16–17 from the Ulam in 8:39, son of Eshek in Saul’s genealogy.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 記事は同名の二人を分け、8:39のウラムをエシェクの子として示す。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: 8:39の系譜との一致が明記され、7:16–17の同名者とも区別。
